subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation peer bindings while preserving documented account-scoped binds?
rationale: The patch can fix the reported peer-binding bug only by changing a public CLI syntax that writes persisted route bindings, so automation cannot safely choose the compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
options.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` account-scoped and add a documented Feishu peer form or plugin-owned recognition path with an account escape and tests.

options.title: Accept Feishu two-segment reinterpretation
options.body: Treat `feishu:<value>` as a conversation peer by default and require upgrade notes, docs, and proof that account-scoped setups remain expressible.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Pause this PR and adopt another open candidate if it better matches the desired bind grammar and proof path.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
recommendation.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` account-scoped and add a documented Feishu peer form or plugin-owned recognition path with an account escape and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the account-scoped bind command surface whose compatibility contract is being changed.
